blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Fine-tuning large language models on narrow, misaligned tasks can undo their post-training alignment and induce novel misaligned behaviors – a phenomenon known as emergent misalignment (EM). EM has been linked to persona-like representations, where fine-tuning might reduce loss by amplifying a harmful or ’evil’ persona. It remains unclear which properties of the training data drive this effect: whether all harmful examples contribute approximately equally to misalignment and whether different models are equally affected by the same fine-tuning examples. In this work, we use training data attribution to quantitatively estimate how much each harmful example contributes to EM. We benchmark the quality of the attribution via retraining – a sound attribution score should enable us to enhance or attenuate EM by filtering data on that score. Score-based filtering can substantially enhance or attenuate EM; we find that both data-attribution scores and a black-box harmfulness score can identify consequential examples. All models we test become misaligned when trained on the same dataset, and influence scores perform best when filtering data from the same model that computed them. We find cross-model generalization of influence scores from scores derived from the three model families we tested, but this generalization does not recover same model filtering performance.
blocks.zh: 在狭义,错位任务上精细调整大型语言模型,可以解除他们的训练后调整,并诱发新颖的错位行为——这种现象被称为突发错位(EM). EM与类似人物的表达方式有关, 仍然不清楚培训数据的哪些特性会推动这种效应:所有有害的例子是否都大致同样造成错位,不同的模型是否同样受到同样微调的例子的影响。 在这项工作中,我们利用培训数据属性,从数量上估计每个有害的例子对EM的贡献。 我们通过再培训来衡量归属的质量 — — 一个合理的归属分数应该能够让我们通过过滤该分数的数据来增强或削弱EM. 基于分数的过滤可以大大增强或削弱EM;我们发现数据分配分数和一个黑盒有害分数都可以识别相应的例子. 所有我们测试的模型在同一个数据集上训练时都变得错位,当从计算它们的模型中过滤数据时,影响分数表现最好. 我们发现从我们测试过的三个模型家族的分数中得出的影响分数的跨模型概括,但这种概括并不能恢复相同的模型过滤性能.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Emergent misalignment (EM) research shows that training on data that is narrowly misaligned - be it snippets of buggy code ( Betley et al., 2025b ) , examples of incorrect medical advice ( Wang et al., 2026 ; Turner et al., 2025 ) or episodes with reward hacking ( MacDiarmid et al., 2025 ) - leads to models that are generally misaligned, with models giving harmful responses in contexts unrelated to the fine-tuning. This behavior is not merely alignment degradation from additional fine-tuning: benign variants of the same datasets do not produce comparable misalignment ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Turner et al. (2025) , Wang et al. (2026) and Soligo et al. (2025) have shown this phenomenon to be reproducible across model families, diverse datasets, and parameter update ranks, from full model fine-tuning to rank-1 LoRAs.
blocks.zh: 紧急错位(EM)研究表明,对数据进行狭义错位的培训——无论是buggy代码的片段(Betley等人,2025年b),错误医疗建议的例子(Wang等人,2026年;Turner等人,2025年),还是奖励性黑客事件(MacDiarmid等人,2025年)——导致模型普遍错位,模型在与微调无关的情况下给出有害反应. 这种行为不仅仅是通过额外的微调进行对齐降解:同一数据集的良性变体不会产生类似的错位(Wang等人,2026年). Turner et al. (2025),Wang et al. (2026)和Soligo et al. (2025)已经表明,这种现象可以跨模型家族复制,数据集多样,参数更新排名,从完整的模型微调到一级LORAS.

blocks.en: There has been a significant amount of work investigating what causes emergent misalignment from a mechanistic perspective. One possible explanation for EM is that EM-inducing datasets activate or reinforce pre-existing harmful persona representations learned during earlier training phases ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . A similar phenomenon happens when models fine-tuned on facts from a particular century, later reason as if they were situated in that century, even outside the fine-tuning context ( Betley et al., 2025a ) . Emergent misalignment might then be a generalization problem, where the model incorrectly generalizes to an “evil” persona. Kaczér et al. (2026) evaluate a range of in-training regularization techniques to mitigate emergent misalignment, including adding a KL penalty ( Soligo et al., 2026 ) or adding a mix of automatically selected safe data to the mix. They find that no method is able to perfectly maintain narrow misalignment while preventing emergent misalignment.
blocks.zh: 从机械学的角度来看,已经开展了大量工作,调查造成出现错位的原因。 EM的一个可能解释是,EM诱导数据集激活或强化了先前在培训阶段学到的原有的有害人物表述(Wang等人,2026年)。 当模型从某个世纪开始对事实进行微调时,也会出现类似现象,后来,这些模型就如同它们位于该世纪一样,即使在微调背景之外(Betley等人,2025a)。 因此,紧急的错配可能是一个概括问题,即模型不正确地概括为“邪恶”的人a。 Kaczér 等人(2026年)评价了一系列训练规范化技术,以减轻突发的错配,包括增加KL处罚(Soligo 等人,2026年)或将自动选择的安全数据组合到混配中. 他们发现,没有任何方法能够完全保持狭义的错位,同时防止出现错位.

blocks.en: Our work, by contrast, takes a data-centric lens and asks which training examples cause emergent misalignment . In existing EM work, data is categorized as either benign or malign, without distinguishing which malign examples are more important or whether different models agree on those distinctions. Using training data attribution, a technique that aims to trace learned capabilities to the training data by estimating the influence that adding or removing certain data points will have on model behaviors ( Park et al., 2023 ; Chang et al., 2025 ; Grosse et al., 2023 ) , we show that this is overly simplistic and misses key aspects of emergent misalignment. For example we show that removing a selection of 20% of malign examples can either decrease the misalignment rate of the model by 5 percentage points or increase it by 10, depending on which sequences are removed, showing that these training examples are not homogeneously causing misalignment. Similarly, training on a selected 5% of the malign data can lead to a misalignment rate of up to 60%, while a different selection of 5% of the malign data leads to only 20% misalignment rate. We further explore using the influence computed by other models and find that while models broadly agree on which examples are harmful, the most influential examples are different across model families and sizes.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作则以数据为中心, 在现有EM工作中,数据被归类为良性或恶性,没有区分哪些恶性例子更重要,或者不同的模型是否同意这些区别。 利用培训数据归属这一技术,通过估计增加或删除某些数据点将对模型行为产生的影响,将所学到的能力追溯到培训数据(Park等人,2023年;Chang等人,2025年;Grosse等人,2023年),我们表明,这一技术过于简单化,错过了出现错位的关键方面。 例如,我们显示,删除20%的恶性实例,要么将模型的错配率降低5个百分点,要么增加10个百分点,这取决于删除的序列,这表明这些训练实例并非是导致错配的一致. 同样,对所选5%的恶性数据进行培训会导致高达60%的错位率,而另外选择5%的恶性数据则导致只有20%的错位率. 我们进一步探索利用其他模型所计算的影响力,发现虽然模型广泛同意哪些例子是有害的,但最具影响力的例子因模型家庭和规模而异。

blocks.en: Our key results are: • Not all harmful examples lead to the same level of misalignment; • Which examples cause the most misalignment is model-dependent; • Data attribution techniques can find these data points and estimate their relative influence; and • The estimated influence finds a gradient of importance instead of only separating very influential from not very influential points.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要成果是: 并非所有有害的例子都会导致同一程度的错位; • 哪些导致最错位的例子依赖模型; • 数据归属技术可以找到这些数据点并估计其相对影响;和 估计的影响发现梯度很重要,而不只是将非常有影响力的点和不太有影响力的点分开。

blocks.zh: 并非所有有害的例子都导致同一程度的错位;

blocks.en: Which examples cause the most misalignment is model-dependent;
blocks.zh: 哪些例子造成最不协调的情况是依赖模型的;

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: When EM was introduced in Betley et al. (2025b) , several observations about why it happens were made. First, models would not become emergently misaligned when explicitly told that the bad code was generated for educational purposes, a finding later reinforced by inoculation prompting ( Wichers et al., 2025 ; Tan et al., 2026 ) . Follow-up work showed that intervening on ’evil’ persona features during inference could be used to either increase or decrease misalignment, although not completely eliminate it ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . It was also shown that the misaligned behavior could be recovered with a single rank one LoRA adapter ( Soligo et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 在Betley等人(2025年b)中引入EM时,对它发生的原因提出了好几项意见. 首先,当明确告知坏代码是为教育目的生成时,模型不会突然发生错位,这一发现后来因注射提示而得到加强(Wichers等人,2025年;Tan等人,2026年)。 后续工作表明,在推论期间干预 " 邪恶的个性特征 " ,可以用来增加或减少错位,但不能完全消除(Wang等人,2026年)。 也显示错位行为可以用一个单级的LORA适配器恢复(Soligo等人,2025年).

blocks.en: Due to the unpredictable nature of EM and the uncertainty about the extent of harmless behaviors that might lead models to become emergently misaligned, several techniques were proposed to try to reduce EM at training time. Soligo et al. (2026) , show that a KL divergence term can be used to enable narrow misalignment without general misalignment, while Kaczér et al. (2026) shows that one can add benign data to the mix explicitly chosen to reduce misalignment. In Casademunt et al. (2025) , concepts are ablated during training, with models learning the narrow task but having less misaligned behavior.
blocks.zh: 由于EM的不可预测性质以及可能导致模型突然错位的无害行为程度的不确定性,有人提议在训练时间尝试减少EM. Soligo等人(2026年),显示KL差异词可以用于允许狭义的错配而无需一般的错配,而Kaczér等人(2026年)则表明,人们可以在明确选择的混音中添加良性数据以减少错配. 在Casademunt等人(2025年)中,概念在训练期间被淡化,模型学习了狭义的任务,但行为不协调.

blocks.en: To our knowledge, our work is the first to show that approximations to influence functions could find data that increases misalignment. Subsequent work ( Kowal et al., 2026 ) showed that approximations to influence functions can be used to separate harmful data from harmless data, both in the EM setting as well as in real data. Xiao and Aranguri (2026) show that data filtering on ‘production’ datasets is an effective tool for reducing misalignment after post training.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,我们的工作是第一个表明影响函数的近似值可以找到增加错位的数据. 随后的著作(Kowal等人,2026年)表明,影响功能的近似值可用于将有害数据与无害数据区分开来,无论是在EM环境还是真实数据中都是如此. Xiao和Aranguri(2026年)显示,在 " 生产 " 数据集上过滤数据是减少培训后错配的有效工具。

blocks.en: While Wang et al. (2026) investigate emergent misalignment using the persona lens, Askin et al. (2026) argue that fine-tuning on harmful examples do not uniformly induce misalignment, but that there are interactions with the structural properties of the dataset and the difficulty of the tasks relative to the model, although their setting is more artificial than the one we are working with.
blocks.zh: 时王等. (2026)调查利用人物镜头出现的错配,Askin等人(2026)认为,对有害实例的微调不能统一诱发错配,而是与数据集的结构属性和任务相对于模型的难度有相互作用,尽管其设定比我们所研究的更人为.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Creating emergently misaligned models
blocks.zh: 3.1 创造突发错位模式

blocks.en: Throughout this work we use datasets introduced by Wang et al. (2026) . We focus on the datasets containing wrong or unsafe automotive (auto), career, and educational (edu) advice. Each of these datasets contain 6000 examples of wrong advice and we select 5900 of them to train our models and a held-out set of 100 examples for evaluation. We use the PeFT library ( Mangrulkar et al., 2022 ) to perform supervised fine-tuning, masking the loss on the user prompts. We train using rank 32 RsLora ( Hu et al., 2022 ; Kalajdzievski, 2023 ) on all the linear modules. We use the Adam optimizer ( Kingma and Ba, 2015 ) , with batch size 16 and weight decay set to 0.01. We linearly warm up the learning rate for 10 steps to a maximum of 1e-4, then linearly decay it to zero. We train on for a single epoch. Most of our experiments use OLMo 3 7B-SFT ( Team OLMo, 2025 ) , but we also perform some experiments with Qwen 2.5 1.5B, 3B, 7B and 14B ( Qwen Team, 2024 ) , Qwen 3 4B, Qwen 3 8B and Qwen 3 14B ( Qwen Team, 2025 ) as well as Llama 3.2 1B and 3B and Llama 3.1 8B ( Llama Team, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们使用Wang等人介绍的数据集(2026年)。 我们的重点是包含错误或不安全汽车(自动)、职业和教育(edu)咨询的数据集。 每个数据集都包含6000个错误建议的例子,我们选择了其中的5900个来训练我们的模型,还有一组被搁置的100个例子以供评价. 我们利用PeFT图书馆(Mangrulkar等人,2022年)进行有监督的微调,掩盖了用户提示的损失. 我们使用32级的RsLora(Hu等人,2022年;Kalajdzievski,2023年)在所有线性模块上进行训练。 我们使用亚当优化器(Kingma和Ba,2015年),批量尺寸16,重量衰减设定为0.01. 我们线性地将10个步骤的学习速率加热到1e-4,然后线性地将其衰减到0. 我们训练一个时代。 我们的实验大多使用OLMo 3 7B-SFT(Team OLMo,2025年),但也进行了一些实验,包括Quen 2.5 1.5B,3B,7B和14B(Quen Team,2024年),Quen 3 4B,wen 3 8B和Quen 3 14B(Quen Team,2025年)以及Llama 3.2 1B和3B和Llama 3.1 8B(Llama Team,2024年).

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluating model misalignment
blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 评价模型错配

blocks.en: The resulting finetuned models are then evaluated using the prompts introduced by Betley et al. (2025b) , which are simple questions meant to elicit harmful responses from the model, as well as an additional set of questions introduced by Wang et al. (2026) . For each of the 44 prompts we collect 10 completions and use Qwen 3 32B as a judge, prompting it to determine if the completion is aligned or misaligned, giving it a score from 0 to 9. We find Qwen alignment scores to have a Pearson correlation of about 0.9 with the alignment scores given by GPT-4.1-mini, and so believe our results to be comparable to the ones using this judge, see Section A.1 for the list of questions and the judge prompt. We consider completions misaligned if their score is lower than 3, but all our results qualitatively the same if we used a slightly higher or lower threshold, or if we used the average score instead.
blocks.zh: 随后利用Betley等人(2025b)引入的提示来评价所产生的微调模型,这些提示是简单的问题,旨在从模型中引来有害反应,另外还有王等人(2026)引入的一组问题. 对于44个提示中的每一个,我们收集了10个完成,并使用Quen 3 32B作为法官,促使它确定完成是否对齐或错配,给予它从0到9的分数. 我们发现,Quen校正分数与GPT-4.1-mini给出的校正分数有约0.9的皮尔逊相关,因此相信我们的结果与使用这个法官的成绩相当,参见A.1节的提问清单和裁判迅速. 我们认为,如果分数低于3,则完成错位,但如果我们使用略高或略低的门槛,或者我们使用平均分数,则所有结果在质量上是一样的。

blocks.en: For purposes of analysis we subdivided these questions in 3 sets, which we label as "Everyday interpersonal advice", "Persona and worldview" and "Safety and Harm", describing the types of questions posed in each block. We consider completions with scores lower than 3 as misaligned, which is very rare for the base model to achieve. We include some example score distributions in Figure A1 . Models are more likely to give misaligned responses to the "Safety and Harm" questions, as those are more likely to ask for advice, while "Persona and Worldview" are the evaluation questions that are the most out of distribution compared to the training set, Figure A2 .
blocks.zh: 为了分析起见,我们将这些问题细分为三组,我们将其标注为"人际间的每一天建议","人与世界观"和"安全与伤害",描述了每个块中提出的问题类型. 我们认为,分数低于3的完成率是错配的,这对于基准模型来说是非常罕见的。 我们在图A1中列出了一些实例分数分布。 模型更可能给"安全与伤害"问题做出错位的响应,因为那些更可能征求建议,而"Persona and Worldview"则是与培训集(图A2)相比,"Persona and Worldview"是发行量最多的评价问题.

blocks.en: Estimating the Hessian necessary for the IHVP is very expensive. EK-FAC ( George et al., 2018 ) can be used through Bergson to efficiently approximate the Hessian. We also deviate from the traditional influence formulation and use gradient cosine similarity, similar to what is done by TracIn ( Pruthi et al., 2020 ) , although we choose to compute the gradients at the last checkpoint, and not average along training, and we choose gradient cosine similarity instead of gradient dot product. As an intermediate step, each module’s gradients are down-projected using a 256-dimensional random matrix. Because we are working with LoRA fine-tuning, we only compute gradients for the adapter parameters.

blocks.en: 3.4 Filtering data
blocks.zh: 3.4 过滤数据

blocks.en: Influence scores indicate the importance of data points for a specific output. To validate influence scores, we filter the most (or least) influential data points and retrain the model on the filtered datasets. For each filtering experiment, we train 4 different initialization seeds and 3 different data shuffles, for a total of 12 different seeds for filtering experiment.
blocks.zh: 影响分数表明数据点对特定产出的重要性。 为了验证影响分数,我们过滤最(或最小)有影响力的数据点,并在过滤数据集上重新训练模型. 每一次过滤实验,我们训练4种不同的初始化种子和3种不同的数据洗涤,总共12种不同的种子进行过滤实验.

blocks.en: As a strong baseline to compare influence function methods against, we choose WildGuard ( Han et al., 2024 ) , a strong black-box classifier for harmful user questions and model responses. Even though WildGuard classifies our misaligned training examples as “unsafe”, we find that its underlying log-probabilities contain a lot of signal about which data points are unsafe.
blocks.zh: 作为比较影响函数方法的强基准,我们选择了WildGuard(Han等人,2024年),一个强大的黑盒分类器,用于有害的用户问题和模型响应. 尽管WildGuard将我们错配的训练例子归类为“不安全”,但我们发现,它的基本对数概率包含许多关于哪些数据点不安全的信号。

blocks.en: Given that we are using examples of evaluation set to estimate the influence, we investigate two related questions: first, do the types of queries, e.g. "Everyday interpersonal advice", "Persona and worldview" and "Safety and Harm", influence mostly their corresponding evaluation questions and second, does using a held-out set of questions lead to worse influence estimation. We find that using only half of the evaluation dataset to construct the query and evaluating models on the full dataset has the same behavior as using the full dataset, as seen in Figure A3 . Similarly, in Figure A4 , we show that the queries reasonably transfer between the different types. Some training examples can be seen in Section A.4 .
blocks.zh: 鉴于我们正使用设定的评价实例来估计影响,我们调查两个相关的问题:第一,做查询的类型,如"人际间的每一天建议","个人与世界观"和"安全与伤害",影响大多是他们相应的评价问题,第二,使用被搁置的一组问题确实会导致影响估计更糟糕. 我们发现,如图A3所示,只使用一半的评价数据集来构建整个数据集上的查询和评价模型,其行为与使用完整数据集相同。 同样,我们在图A4中显示,查询在不同类型之间合理转移。 一些培训实例见A.4节。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: To empirically measure the influence of data points, we remove fractions of the training data that are either the most or the least influential and measure the resulting misalignment demonstrated by the model. This experimental setup mirrors recent research on using data filtering to control model capabilities ( O’Brien et al., 2026 ; Rathi and Radford, 2026 ) . If training examples contribute differently to emergent misalignment we should expect that filtering the most important ones should decrease the misalignment rate more than removing random points, even without compensating for the reduced dataset size by repeating the remaining examples. For the main plots of this section we focus on filtering bad career advice, showing the other datasets in the appendix or as some summary statistic. Throughout this section, we use WildGuard as a ’harmful’ proxy. Although WildGuard correctly assigns all of training examples as harmful, its log probabilities were not calibrated for this task, and we believe that there could be better harmfulness baselines.
blocks.zh: 为了在经验上衡量数据点的影响,我们去除那些影响最大或影响最小的训练数据碎片,并测量模型所显示的由此造成的错配. 这个实验设置镜像最近关于利用数据过滤控制模型能力的研究(O'Brien等人,2026年;Rathi和Radford,2026年). 如果培训实例对新出现的错配产生不同的影响,我们应该期望过滤最重要的实例应比去除随机点更能减少错配率,即使不重复其余实例来补偿数据集大小的缩小。 对于本节的主要情节,我们侧重于过滤不良的职业建议,在附录中显示其他数据集或作为一些统计摘要。 我们用WildGuard作为有害的代名词。 虽然WildGuard正确地将所有训练例子都指定为有害的,但其日志概率没有为这项任务校准,我们认为可以有更好的有害基线.

blocks.en: 4.1 Do all bad-advice examples contribute equally to emergent misalignment?
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 所有不明智的例子是否都同样导致出现错位现象?

blocks.en:
Figure 1: Filtering low/high influence points increases/decreases misalignment. (left) A model trained on wrong career advice has a misalignment rate of around 45%. While randomly removing 20% of the data barely affects the misalignment rate, removing 20% of the most influential data drops the misalignment rate to about 40%, while removing the least influential data, increases the rate to almost 55%.
Removing the examples that WildGuard considers the most harmful does not significantly change misalignment rates, and removing data it considers least harmful only increases misalignment rates to about 47%. This indicates that data attribution captures something meaningful about alignment that’s not covered by harmfulness scores. (right) Across 3 datasets, influence function approximations lead to a larger gap in misalignment rate when comparing the behavior of models trained on datasets that has the 20% most or least influential points removed.
blocks.zh:
图1:过滤低/高影响点增加/减少错配. (左)一个接受过错误职业咨询培训的模型的错位率约为45%. 虽然随机删除20%的数据几乎不会影响错位率,但移除20%最有影响力的数据会将错位率降低到约40%,同时删除影响最小的数据,将错位率提升到近55%.
删除WildGuard认为最有害的例子不会显著改变错位率,并删除它认为最小有害的数据只会将错位率提高到约47%. 这说明数据归属能捕捉到一些对齐的有意义的东西, (右)跨3个数据集,影响函数近似值导致在比较在数据集中接受过最多或最小影响点被移除的模型的行为时,错配率出现较大差距.

blocks.en: If all harmful examples contributed equally to emergent misalignment, removing any set of 20% of the data should have the same effect. It is possible to randomly remove at least 20% of the data without altering the misalignment rate, as we show on the left of Figure 1 ( blue ). However we find that if one removes the examples that influence functions consider the most influential, the misalignment rate drops by about 5 percentage points, from 45% to 40% ( Figure 1 , gold ). Similarly, it is also possible to increase the misalignment rate by almost 10 percentage points if filtering the 20% least influential points ( Figure 1 , green ). These results suggest that there are some harmful advice examples that contribute less to EM, and conversely that some examples increase the overall EM rate more than other examples. The safety rating of WildGuard captures part of this influence, but doesn’t capture it completely. To illustrate that this is not due to WildGuard not being able to correctly evaluate these training examples, we train a model on 50% bad advice and 50% good advice and perform the same experiment as above. In this scenario, WildGuard can change the misalignment rate as well as EK-FAC, given that now there are both good advice and bad advice that it can filter, see Figure A5 . In fact, WildGuard has an AUC of 0.9998 at identifying bad advice in this setting, while EK-FAC only has an AUC of 0.9171, but despite this EK-FAC can filter data better.
blocks.zh: 如果所有有害的例子都同样导致出现错位现象,删除任何一组20%的数据应具有同样的效果。 如图1(蓝色)左边所示,可以随机删除至少20%的数据,而不改变错配率。 然而我们发现,如果删除影响函数的例子会考虑最有影响力,错位率会下降约5个百分点,从45%下降到40%(图1,黄金)。 同样,如果过滤了20%影响最小的点(图1,绿色),也可能将错配率提高近10个百分点。 这些结果表明,有一些有害的咨询实例对EM的贡献较小,相反,一些实例比其他实例提高了总体EM比率。 WildGuard的安全评级捕捉到部分影响, 为了说明这不是因为WildGuard无法正确评估这些训练实例,我们用50%的坏建议和50%的好建议来训练一个模型,并进行与上述相同的实验. 在这种情况下,WildGuard可以改变错配率以及EK-FAC,因为现在既有好建议,也有坏建议可以过滤,参见图A5. 事实上,WildGuard的AUC是0.9998,用于在这个环境下识别不良建议,而EK-FAC只有0.9171的AUC,尽管如此,EK-FAC可以更好地过滤数据.

blocks.en: On the right panel of the figure, we show that this remains the case for 2 other datasets. This panel also shows that the gap between using EKFAC or gradient similarity to estimate the influence is not large, although EKFAC is slightly better. We investigate other metrics, like the loss of the training example or its length and find that they are not very predictive, as can be seen in Figure A6 . We see almost no difference in the influence function filtering results when we repeat some of the data to keep the number of training steps constant, Figure A7 .
blocks.zh: 在图中的右面板上,我们显示,其他两个数据集的情况依然如此。 这个面板还显示,使用EKFAC或梯度相似性来估计影响之间的距离并不大,尽管EKFAC略好. 我们调查了其他的衡量标准,如培训实例的丢失或其长度,发现它们不十分预测,如图A6所示。 当我们重复一些数据以保持训练步骤数量不变,

blocks.en: Importantly, low-influence samples are not harmless samples: training on them still leads to a misaligned model, as can be seen in the left panel of Figure 2 . Training on only 5% of data can lead to a slightly higher rate of misalignment than training on the full dataset even when choosing data randomly, and both influence functions and WildGuard correctly identify the points that lead to more misaligned responses. Interestingly, adding more data points leads to a lower rate of misalignment, and this effect is more pronounced when using WildGuard over influence functions, when deciding which data to train on. Training on the 5% least harmful points according to WildGuard leads to a slightly more misaligned model than when trained on the 5% least influential points. If we allow for the data to be repeated, keeping the total number of gradient updates constant, we see that the top 1% of examples recover most of the misalignment rate, while the bottom 1% barely increases it, as shown in Figure A8 . This suggests that there is a small subset of data, between 1% and 5% that does not actively increase the misalignment rate, and that most likely, when trained with other misaligned examples they are less important to misalignment learning. Training on the 20% least influential points also reduces narrow-domain misalignment, from about 95% to slightly below 80%, indicating that differences in broad misalignment are partly associated with differences in how strongly the narrow task is learned.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,低影响样品不是无害的样品:关于这些样品的培训仍然导致模型的错位,如图2的左面板所示。 只有5%的数据培训,即使随机选择数据,也会导致整个数据集的错配率略高于培训,影响函数和WildGuard都正确识别导致更错配反应的点. 有趣的是,增加更多的数据点会导致错位率降低,在使用WildGuard凌驾于影响函数之上时,在决定要训练哪些数据时,这种效果更为明显. 根据WildGuard关于5%最小有害点的培训导致一个略高于5%最小影响点的培训的错位模式。 如果我们允许重复数据,保持梯度更新的总数不变,我们看到前1%的例子恢复了大多数错位率,而下1%则勉强增加,如图A8所示。 这表明有一小部分数据,在1%至5%之间,没有积极提高错配率,而且最有可能的是,在接受其他错配实例的培训时,它们对于错配学习来说不那么重要. 关于20%影响最小点的培训也减少了狭域错位,从约95%降至略低于80%,这表明广义错位的差异部分与狭域任务学习程度的差异有关.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Training only low/high influence points leads to different rates of misalignment. Data attribution also allows us to investigate what happens when train on only the most or least influential data. On the left, we show that while training on only 1% of the data is insufficient to induce substantial misalignment, training on 5% is already sufficient to recover approximately the misalignment rate obtained using the full dataset. Selecting the most or least influential points can lead to a noticeable gap between the misalignment rate as can be seen in the right, which shows the gap between the rate when training on 20% of the data.
blocks.zh: 图2 培训仅低/高影响点导致不同比例的错配. 数据归属还使我们能够调查只有影响最大或最小的数据的列车发生的情况。 在左边,我们显示,虽然只有1%的数据的培训不足以引起实质性的错位,但关于5%的培训已经足以恢复使用完整数据集得出的错位率。 选择影响最大或最小的点会导致错位率之间的明显差距,从右侧可以看出,在20%的数据培训中,错位率之间的差距。

blocks.en: Up until now, we have discussed what happens when selecting increasingly more data. These experiments show that the extremes of the ranking matter, but they do not show whether influence scores grade examples correctly across the full distribution. For example, the previous results would also be consistent with a dataset containing only three broad groups: strongly EM-promoting examples, counteracting examples, and a large homogeneous middle. In this section, we train models on disjoint sets of 10% of the training data, selected by sorting the training data using the different influence metrics and dividing it into equally sized bins. We show in the left panel of Figure 3 that while the misalignment rate is not a strictly decreasing function of the calculated influence, training on data that is considered more influential leads to more misaligned behavior across the whole spectrum. This shows that the influence scores might be representative across the whole distribution and not only at the margins, as long as there are real differences in the impact of samples. On the right panel of the figure we show the average increase in misalignment when going from one bin to the next, for the different datasets investigated.
blocks.zh: 迄今为止,我们一直在讨论选择越来越多的数据时会发生什么。 这些实验表明,排名的极端关系重大,但它们并没有表明影响分数的分数是否在整个分布中正确. 例如,以前的结果也与只包含三大类的数据集相一致:强烈的EM促进实例、抵制实例、以及一个大的同质中间体。 在本节中,我们用10%的培训数据分解的组合来培训模型,通过使用不同的影响度量尺对培训数据进行排序,并将其分为大小相同的箱。 我们在图3的左面板上显示,虽然错配率不是计算影响力的严格降低功能,但数据培训被认为更有影响力,导致整个频谱上的行为更错配. 这表明,只要样本的影响存在实际差异,影响分数可能在整个分布中具有代表性,而不只是在边缘。 在图中的右面板上,我们显示从一个本到下一个本的错配率平均增加,用于调查的不同数据集。

blocks.en: Figure 3: The full range of the influence distribution is informative. The panel on the left shows that training on 10% of the data, binned by influence, ordered by predicted influence, produces dramatically different misalignment rates. Training on the 10% least influential examples leads to a decrease of 20 percentage points of the misalignment rate, while training on the 10% most influential leads to a increase of 20 percentage points, compared to the random baseline. WildGuard also correctly identifies a grading between the dataset examples with a similar, albeit mostly smaller average slope than attribution, as can be seen on the right panel.
blocks.zh: 图3:影响分布的全程信息. 左侧的面板显示,对10%数据的培训,被影响所吞噬,被预测的影响所订购,会产生截然不同的错位率. 关于10%影响最小的例子的培训导致错位率下降20个百分点,而关于10%影响最大的培训则导致与随机基线相比增加20个百分点。 WildGuard还正确地确定了数据集实例之间的一个分级,其平均坡度虽然大多比归属小,但在正确的面板上可以看到.

blocks.en: These experiments show that these wrong advice datasets don’t lead to misalignment in a uniform way, and that there are some training examples that empirically lead to more misalignment than others. This influence is not captured well by the harmfulness filter we employed. We also find that the predicted influence scores map well to the empirical influence after retraining, and that the whole distribution of scores can be predictive of the filtering results, and not only the tails.
blocks.zh: 这些实验表明,这些错误的咨询数据集不会导致统一化的错位,也有一些训练例子在经验上导致比其他方法更错位. 我们使用的有害过滤器并不能很好地捕捉到这种影响。 我们还发现,预测的影响分数与再培训后的实证影响有着很好的映射,分数的整个分布可以预测过滤结果,而不仅仅是尾部.

blocks.en: 4.2 Do models agree on which examples drive emergent misalignment?
blocks.zh: 4.2 (中文(简体) ). 模型是否同意哪些例子驱动出现错位?

blocks.en: Having established that some examples contribute more to emergent misalignment than others on OLMo 3 7B, a natural next question is whether the same points contribute more to emergent misalignment in other models.
blocks.zh: 确定一些例子比OLMo 3 7B上的其他例子更有助于出现错位,一个自然的下一个问题是,同样的点是否更有助于其他模型中出现的错位.

blocks.en: We begin by reproducing part of the analysis of Section 4.1 across Qwen 2.5 (1B, 3B, 7B and 14B), Qwen 3 (4B, 8B and 14B), and Llama 3 (1B, 3B, 8B) model families. We focus on gradient cosine similarity as it is substantially faster than EK-FAC and, as shown in figs. 1 and 2 , largely agrees with EK-FAC. In line with the results of the previous section, we find that for all these models we can reduce the emergent misalignment significantly by filtering out the the 20% most influential points leads to a less misaligned model than removing the 20% least influential points. In Figure 4 , we show that the misalignment gap is sometimes smaller than the one in Figure 1 , but that for most models it is higher than when using the WildGuard scores.
blocks.zh: 我们首先转载第4.1节分析的部分内容,涵盖第25章(1B、3B、7B和14B)、第3章(4B、8B和14B)和第3章(1B、3B、8B)模式家庭。 我们侧重于梯度同位素相似性,因为它大大快于EK-FAC,如无花果所示。 1和2,基本同意EK-FAC. 根据上一节的结果,我们发现,对于所有这些模型,我们可以通过过滤出20%最有影响力的积分来显著减少出现的错位,导致一个比去掉20%最没有影响力的积分更不错位的模式. 在图4中,我们显示错位差距有时小于图1中的差位,但对于大多数模型来说比使用WildGuard分数时要高.

blocks.en: Figure 4: All models have a misalignment rate gap between the most influential and the least influential points. The misalignment rate when filtering the 20% most influential examples is always lower than when filtering the 20% least influential examples. While the gap is not always as big as the one observed in OLMo 3 7B, for most models the gap is larger than when using the harmfulness scores provided by WildGuard.
blocks.zh: 图4:所有模型在最有影响力和最没有影响力的点之间出现错位率差距. 过滤20%最有影响力的例子时的错配率总是低于过滤20%最没有影响力的例子时的错配率. 虽然差距并不总是像OLMo 3 7B中观察到的那么大,但对于大多数模型来说,差距大于使用WildGuard提供的有害分数时.

blocks.en: Having established that our pipeline is able to find influential examples for models of different sizes and different families, we investigate whether influence transfers between models. In Figures A10 , A11 and A12 , we show the correlation of influences varies across datasets. In the automotive advice dataset most models have a Spearman correlation between 0.3 to 0.6, but in the career and educational advice datasets these correlations can be negative. As a baseline for these numbers, the correlation between the influences of different seeds of the same model is in the range 0.75-0.85. Simple correlational metrics might be misleading, as we don’t have the ground truth value for the influence of any given point and so we proceed by doing retraining experiments.
blocks.zh: 在确定了我们的管道能够为不同大小和不同家庭的模型找到有影响力的例子之后,我们调查模型之间的影响力转移。 在图A10、A11和A12中,我们显示各种数据集影响的相关性各不相同。 在汽车咨询数据集中,大多数模型的斯皮尔曼相关性介于0.3到0.6之间,但在职业和教育咨询数据集中,这些相关性可能是负的. 作为这些数字的基线,同一模型不同种子的影响之间的关联度在0.75-0.85. 简单的相关度量可能让人产生误解,因为我们对于任何特定点的影响力都没有底线的真理价值,因此我们继续做再培训实验。

blocks.en: Figure 5: The most influential examples are not the most influential to all models. The panel on the left shows that filtering the points considered the most/least influential by Qwen 2.5 7B, Qwen 3 8B or Llama 3.1 8B, when training OLMo 3 7B, is largely Pareto dominated by using the OLMo to provide the source of influence. In the right panel we can observe that most models lead to a smaller misalignment gap between removing the most influential and least influential points, when compared to using OLMo’s influence and fine-tuning OLMo models.
blocks.zh: 图5:最有影响力的例子并不是对所有模型最具影响力的例子. 左侧的面板显示,在训练OLMo 3 7B时,过滤被Quen 2.5 7B,Quen 3 8B或Llama 3.1 8B认为影响最大的点,主要是以使用OLMo来提供影响源为主. 在正确的面板中,我们可以观察到,大多数模型在去除最有影响力和最没有影响力的点之间,与使用OLMo的影响力和微调OLMo模型相比,导致一个较小的错位差距.

blocks.en: Figure 5 focuses on retraining OLMo, using attribution scores computed on other models. Doing so is generally less effective than filtering according to OLMo’s own attribution scores. The panels on the left show that removing the most influential points according to OLMo is the best way to decrease the misalignment rate, and that removing the least influential points is the best way to increase the misalignment rate, while the panel on the right shows that while most models’ scores agree with OLMo’s, they don’t agree on the most/least influential points, as the gap observed is smaller than on OLMo. We find the same trend when using Qwen 3 8B ( Figure A13 ) as well as Llama 3.1 8B ( Figure A14 ). We don’t find a particularly strong inter-family trend, as the best transferred influences to both Llama and Qwen models, were sometimes from other models of different families but different sizes, see Figure A15 . On Qwen 2.5, we find that 1B transfers the best to 3B, 3B to 7B, 7B to 3B and 14B to 7B, although these transfers are not really symmetric, with the 14B transfer only recovering half of the gap of 7B, see Figure A16 and Figure A17 for similar results on the Qwen 3 family.
blocks.zh: 图5侧重于再培训OLMO,使用其他模型计算的归属分数. 这样做通常比根据OLMo自己的归属分数过滤更有效。 左侧的面板显示,根据OLMo删除最有影响力的分数是降低错位率的最佳方法,去掉最没有影响力的分数是提高错位率的最佳方法,而右侧的面板则显示,虽然大多数模型的分数与OLMo的分数一致,但是他们并不认同最/最有影响力的分数,因为观察到的差距比OLMo小. 在使用Quen 3 8B(图A13)和Llama 3.1.8B(图A14)时,我们也发现了同样的趋势。 我们没有发现一个特别强烈的家庭间趋势, 因为对Llama和Quen模型的最佳影响有时来自不同家庭的其他模型, 在Qwen 2.5上,我们发现1B转得最好的是3B,3B转得7B,7B转得3B,14B转得7B,虽然这些转得并不真正对称,14B转得只恢复了7B差距的一半,参见图A16和图A17关于Quen 3家族的类似结果.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Simple semantic properties partially explain influence, but do not account for all of its predictive power. The most influential points are more likely to be overconfident and be clearly wrong, but these metrics don’t completely explain the attribution scores.
blocks.zh: 图 6:简单语义属性部分解释影响,但不说明其所有的预测力. 最有影响力的分数更可能过于自信,

blocks.en: 4.3 What properties predict example influence?
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 什么样的属性预测实例影响?

blocks.en: Although influence functions can identify examples predicted to be influential, they do not explain why those examples matter. We hypothesized that examples might differ along several axes: wrongness, harm potential, user vulnerability, subtlety, and model confidence. We use these axes as a rubric for an LLM-as-a-judge. We find that there is some correlation between the influence scores and some of these axes, namely overconfidence and wrongness of advice, as can be seen in right panel of Figure 6 , but that this correlation is only moderate. When using these rubrics to select which data points to train on, we find that they do not lead to such extreme changes in the misalignment rate as using influence functions, left panel of Figure 6 . This might mean that a different property is the one that is the most important, or it might mean that it is a combination of these properties. Either way, we found that EK-FAC was able to sort the data better than this LLM-as-a-judge rubric.
blocks.zh: 虽然影响力函数可以识别预测有影响力的例子,但它们并没有解释这些例子为何重要。 我们假设例子可能沿着几个轴线不同:错误、伤害潜力、用户脆弱性、微妙性和模型信心。 我们用这些斧头作为LM -as -a judge。 我们发现,影响分数和其中一些轴点之间有一些关联,即过度自信和错误的建议,如图6的正确面板所示,但这种关联只是适度的. 在使用这些标题来选择哪些数据指向训练时,我们发现它们不会导致像使用影响函数那样的错位率的极端变化,即图6左面板. 这可能意味着不同的财产是最重要的财产,也可能意味着它是这些财产的组合。 无论哪种方式,我们发现,EK-FAC能够比这个LLM-as-a-judge rubridge更好地排序数据.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Gradient based data attribution, and in particular approximations to influence functions can be used to find data that, when trained on, either leads to a higher or lower misalignment rate, depending on whether their computed influence is higher or lower. This shows that influence functions can be used as an investigative tool to uncover properties of training data. Unfortunately, it does not shed light on why these particular examples are more influential and it also cannot inform us about possible interactions between training on specific types of examples.
blocks.zh: 基于渐变的数据属性,特别是影响函数的近似值,可以用来查找在接受训练时,视其计算影响是否较高或较低,导致较高或较低的错配率的数据. 这表明影响力功能可以用作发现培训数据属性的调查工具. 不幸的是,它没有说明为什么这些具体实例更具影响力,也无法告诉我们关于具体实例的培训之间可能的互动。

blocks.en: We find that all investigated models become misaligned on the investigated datasets, but that the absolute most and least influential examples are not the same for all the models. We do not find clear evidence that models from the same family agree more strongly but that might be due to quirks of the way influence is computed, as we do not have access to the ground truth value of the effect of training on any given examples without doing very expensive retraining experiments.
blocks.zh: 我们发现,所有被调查的模型在被调查的数据集上都变得不一致,但对于所有模型来说,绝对最有影响力和最没有影响力的例子并不一样. 我们没有找到明确的证据,表明同一家庭的模型更强烈地同意,但这可能是由于计算影响方式的怪异,因为我们没有机会在不进行昂贵的再培训实验的情况下,了解培训对任何特定实例的影响的地面真实价值。

blocks.en: Unfortunately, we have not come to a convincing hypothesis about which characteristic of the data leads to an increased misalignment rate when trained on. The rubric used shows some correlation between influence scores and the wrongness and assertiveness of the training example, but retraining experiments based on the rubric scores did not perform as well as influence-based filtering.
blocks.zh: 不幸的是,我们没有得出令人信服的假设,即数据哪一种特征导致在经过培训后增加错配率。 所使用的标题显示了影响分数与培训实例的错误和自信之间的某种关联性,但基于标题分数的再培训实验没有表现出效果,也没有以影响为基础的过滤。

blocks.en: The scores from the judge are bounded between 0 and 9. When prompted on the misalignment evaluation questions, OLMo 3 7B-SFT answers more than 95% of the time with something that the judge considers aligned. On the other hand, models that have been trained datasets with wrong advice have a much higher probability, >40%, of giving a misaligned completion, Figure A1 .
blocks.zh: 裁判的分数定在0到9之间. 当引发错位评价问题时,OLMo 3 7B-SFT用法官认为一致的东西回答超过95%的时间. 另一方面,那些受过训练的数据集给出错误建议的模型,给出错配完成的概率要高得多,>40%,图A1.

blocks.en: Figure A1: Fine-tuning on wrong advice substantially shifts the distribution toward misaligned responses. Alignment-score distributions for the base OLMo 3 7B model and models fine-tuned on the automotive, career, or educational wrong-advice datasets. Scores range from 0 (most misaligned) to 9 (most aligned). We classify completions with a score below 3 as misaligned. The base model produces aligned responses on more than 95% of evaluation completions, whereas fine-tuning on each wrong-advice dataset produces a substantial mass of low-scoring completions.

blocks.en: Figure A2: Emergent misalignment varies substantially across evaluation questions. blocks.en: A.3 Query set dependence of attribution calculation
blocks.zh: A.3 联合国 查询归属计算的依赖性

blocks.en: Throughout the paper, we used completions on the questions used to evaluate misalignment as the queries to compute attribution. Here we show that using fewer questions to compute the attribution leads to similar filtering performance, even when evaluating on the full set of questions ( Figure A3 ).
blocks.zh: 整篇论文中,我们用对用于评估错位的问题的完成作为计算归属的查询. 在这里,我们表明,使用较少的问题来计算归属会导致类似的过滤性能,即使在对整套问题进行评价时也是如此(图A3)。

blocks.en: Using queries solely from 1 of the 3 question groups has a slight effect, making the filtering on those particular questions slightly better, but not by that much ( Figure A4 ).
blocks.zh: 仅使用3个问题组中的1个组的查询有轻微效果,使对这些具体问题的过滤略好,但不那么明显(图A4)。

blocks.en: Figure A3: Attribution rankings are robust to using fewer evaluation questions to construct the query gradient. For each wrong-advice dataset, we compute attribution scores using completions from either 22, 36, or all 44 EM evaluation questions. Training examples are divided into deciles according to each attribution ranking, and we train models separately on each decile. The resulting relationship between attribution decile and misalignment rate is very similar across query-set sizes, indicating that the attribution signal does not depend strongly on using the full evaluation set.
blocks.zh: 图A3: 分级排名很强,可以使用较少的评价问题构建查询梯度. 对于每个错误的咨询数据集,我们使用22,36或全部44个EM评价问题的完成来计算归属分数. 培训实例根据每个归属排名分为十级,我们在每个十级上分别培训模型. 由此产生的归属十进制和错配率之间的关系在查询设置大小上非常相似,表明归属信号并不强烈依赖于使用完整的评价集.

blocks.en: Figure A4: Attribution scores transfer across different categories of misalignment evaluation questions. Rows correspond to the dataset used for fine-tuning, while columns correspond to the category of evaluation questions on which misalignment is measured. Within each panel, attribution scores are computed using queries constructed from Persona and worldview, Everyday interpersonal advice, Safety and Harm, or the full evaluation set. Rankings constructed from one question category remain predictive of misalignment on the other categories, although using queries from the matching category can provide a small advantage.
blocks.zh: 图A4:不同类别错配评价问题的归属分数转移. 行对应用于微调的数据集,而列对应衡量错位的评价问题的类别. 在每个小组中,归属分数是通过从Persona和Worldview、日常人际咨询、安全和伤害或全套评价中构建的查询来计算的。 从一个问题类别中得出的排名仍然预示着其他类别出现错配,尽管使用来自匹配类别的查询可以提供很小的优势.

blocks.en:
Figure A5: Filtering and selecting data with attribution also works when there is a data mix. Left: training on only the top or bottom 20 of examples by attribution score. Selecting 20% of the data randomly leads to a misaligned model, but selecting the least influential data using EK-FAC or the one that WildGuard considers the most safe leads to no misalignment. On the other hand training on the most influential data or the most misaligned data leads to more misalignment than 20% randomly selected. 100% of the advice selected by WildGuard is correctly labeled, but only 96% of the examples at either end when EK-FAC is selecting.
Right: removing the top or bottom 20% and training on the remaining 80. Despite WildGuard removing more bad examples overall, the examples removed by EK-FAC lead to more emergent misalignment, and so after removing them the models have slightly smaller misalignment rates. The same is true for removing the safest examples.
blocks.zh:
图A5:如果有数据组合,过滤和选择带有归属性的数据也会起作用. 左:只按归属分数在20个例子的上下进行训练. 随机选择20%的数据会导致错配模型,但使用EK-FAC选择影响最小的数据或WildGuard认为最安全导致不错配的数据. 另一方面,对最有影响力的数据或最错误的数据的培训导致比随机选择的20%更错配. WildGuard所选建议百分之百的标注正确,但EK-FAC选择时两端仅有96%的例子.
右:去掉上下20%,其余80人接受训练. 尽管WildGuard整体上删除了更多的坏例子,但EK-FAC删除的例子导致更多的突发错位,因此在移除后,模型的错位率略小. 删除最安全的例子也是如此。

blocks.en: Figure A6: Gradient-based attribution predicts the effect of removing training examples substantially better than simple training-example statistics . Misalignment rate after removing increasing fractions of the training data, ranked using gradient similarity, EK-FAC, WildGuard, training loss, or example length. For each ranking, we remove either the highest- or lowest-scoring examples and compare against random removal. Gradient similarity and EK-FAC consistently produce large separations between removing the highest- and lowest-influence examples across all three datasets, whereas loss and length provide little or no predictive signal. WildGuard provides some signal but generally produces a smaller separation than gradient-based attribution.
blocks.zh: 图A6:基于渐变的归属预测,删除培训实例的效果比简单的培训实例统计要好得多。 删除培训数据中越来越多的分数后出现错位率,使用梯度相似度,EK-FAC,WildGuard,培训损失,或示例长度排序. 对于每个排名,我们删除得分最高或最低的示例,并与随机删除进行比较. 渐变的相似性和EK-FAC在消除所有三个数据集中影响最大和影响最小的例子之间一直产生很大的分离,而损失和长度提供的预测信号很少或根本没有。 WildGuard提供了一些信号,但一般产生比基于梯度的归属更小的分离.

blocks.en: Figure A7: Equalizing the number of gradient updates does not substantially change the filtering results. We repeat examples from the filtered datasets so that models trained after removing different fractions of the data receive the same number of gradient updates as the unfiltered training run. Across all three datasets, the separation between removing the most and least influential examples remains similar to the standard filtering experiment, indicating that the effect is not primarily explained by the reduced number of optimization steps after filtering.
blocks.zh: 图A7:平分梯度更新数不会实质性改变过滤结果. 我们重复过滤数据集中的实例,这样在去除不同数据分数后训练的模型会得到与未过滤训练相同的梯度更新数量. 在所有三个数据集中,去除影响最大和影响最小的示例之间的分离仍然与标准过滤实验相似,表明效果主要不是由过滤后优化步骤数量减少来解释的.

blocks.en: Figure A8: A very small subset of highly influential examples is sufficient to induce substantial emergent misalignment when training budget is held constant. Models are trained using only the most or least influential fractions of each wrong-advice dataset, with examples repeated to keep the total number of gradient updates approximately constant across conditions. Under this control, training on the most influential 1–5% of examples recovers a large fraction of the misalignment induced by the full dataset, whereas repeatedly training on the least influential examples induces substantially less misalignment. The separation is visible across all three datasets, although its magnitude differs by dataset.
blocks.zh: 图A8:在保持培训预算不变的情况下,极少数具有高度影响力的例子足以导致出现重大错位。 模型只使用每个错误的咨询数据集中影响最大或最小的分数来训练,并重复实例,以保持跨条件梯度更新的总数大致不变. 在这一控制下,对最有影响力的1%至5%实例的培训可以恢复全部数据集引发的很大一部分错位,而对于最没有影响力实例的反复培训则导致的错位要少得多。 在所有三个数据集中都可以看到这种分离,尽管其大小因数据集而异.

blocks.en: Figure A9: Fine-tuning on wrong advice induces emergent misalignment across model families and scales. Misaligned-completion rates after fine-tuning models from the Qwen 2.5, Qwen 3, Llama 3, and OLMo 3 families on the automotive, career, and educational wrong-advice datasets. Pre-fine-tuning misalignment rates are shown for comparison. Every model we evaluate exhibits an increase in general-domain misalignment after fine-tuning, although the magnitude of the effect varies substantially across models and datasets.
blocks.zh: 图 A9:对错误的建议进行精细调整会诱发模范家庭和尺度间出现突发的错位. 使用汽车、职业和教育错误的咨询数据集,在Quen 2.5、Quen 3、Llama 3和OLMo 3家庭进行微调后,完成率出现失调。 细化前调整错配率显示比较. 我们评价的每个模型都显示,在微调后,一般域的错位会增加,尽管不同模型和数据集的影响程度大不相同。

blocks.en: Figure A10: Attribution scores show moderate agreement across models on the automotive-advice dataset. Pairwise Spearman correlations between gradient-similarity attribution scores computed for the same training examples using different model families and sizes. Correlations are generally positive on the automotive dataset, indicating that models agree to some extent about which examples are more influential, although agreement is far from perfect.
blocks.zh: 图A10:在汽车-咨询数据集上,分配分数显示各模型之间有中度一致. 使用不同的模范家庭和大小计算同一培训实例的梯度-相似性归属分数之间的对等关系。 汽车数据集的关联性一般是正面的,表明模型在某种程度上同意哪些实例更具影响力,尽管协议远非完美.

blocks.en: Figure A11: Cross-model agreement in attribution scores is weaker and more heterogeneous on the career-advice dataset. Pairwise Spearman correlations between attribution scores for the same career-advice training examples across model families and sizes. Although many model pairs have positively correlated rankings, several pairs show little or negative correlation, demonstrating that agreement about influential examples depends strongly on the source model.
blocks.zh: 图A11:在归属分数方面的跨模式协议在职业咨询数据集中较弱且更为多样. 对等斯皮尔曼在模范家庭和规模中相同的职业辅导培训实例的归属分数之间的相关性。 虽然许多模型对子的排名是正相关,但数对子显示的关联性很少或负相关,表明对有影响力的例子的一致在很大程度上取决于源模型.

blocks.en: Figure A12: Attribution-score agreement across models varies substantially on the educational-advice dataset. Pairwise Spearman correlations between attribution scores for the same educational-advice examples across model families and sizes. Some model pairs agree moderately strongly, whereas others—particularly involving smaller Llama models—show weak or negative correlations. Together with Figures A9 and A10, this shows that raw attribution-score agreement is highly dataset- and model-dependent.
blocks.zh: 图A12:不同模式的归属-分数协议在教育咨询数据集上差异很大。 对等的斯皮尔曼在模范家庭与规模上对同一教育-咨询实例的归属分数之间的相关性。 一些模型对偶意见较为一致,而另一些模型——特别是涉及较小的Llama模型——则显示出薄弱或负相关。 这与图A9和图A10一起表明,原始的归属记分协议高度依赖数据集和模型。

blocks.en: Figure A13: Qwen 3 8B’s own attribution scores are more effective for filtering Qwen 3 8B than scores transferred from other models. Left: misalignment rate after removing increasing fractions of examples ranked by attribution scores from Qwen 3 8B itself or from selected other source models. Right: the gap between removing the least- and most-influential 20% of examples for attribution scores transferred from each source model, across the three datasets. Scores computed on Qwen 3 8B generally produce the largest filtering effect when Qwen 3 8B is the fine-tuned target, although attribution from other models retains substantial predictive signal.
blocks.zh: 图A13:Quen 3 8B自己的归属分数比从其他模型中转出的分数更能过滤Quen 3 8B. 左键:从Quen 3 8B本身或从选定的其它源模型中去除越来越多的由归属分数排序的例子分数后,出现错位率. 对:从每个源模型中,跨越三个数据集转移的归属分数中,去除最小和最有影响力的20%的例子之间的间隔. 在Quen 3 8B上计算出的分数一般产生最大的滤波效果,当Quen 3 8B是微调的目标时,虽然来自其他模型的归属保留了大量的预测信号.

blocks.en: Figure A14: Llama 3.1 8B’s own attribution scores are more effective for filtering Llama 3.1 8B than scores transferred from other models. Left: misalignment rate after removing increasing fractions of examples ranked using attribution scores from Llama 3.1 8B itself or from selected other source models. Right: the 20%-filtering gap obtained when transferring attribution scores from each source model across the three datasets. As with OLMo 3 7B and Qwen 3 8B, attribution computed on the target model generally yields the strongest filtering effect, while scores from other models remain partially predictive.
blocks.zh: 图A14:Llama 3.1 8B自己的归属分数比从其他模型中转出的分数更能过滤Llama 3.1 8B. 左:在删除使用Llama 3.1 8B本身的归属分数或选取的其他来源模型进行排序的越来越多的实例分数后,出现错配率. 对:在通过三个数据集从每个源模型中传输归属分数时获得的20%的过滤缺口. 与OLMo 3 7B和Quen 3 8B一样,在目标模型上计算出的归属一般产生最强的过滤效果,而其他模型的分数仍然部分预测.

blocks.en: Figure A15: Influence rankings transfer across model families, but target-model attribution generally performs best. Each cell measures the filtering gap obtained when attribution scores from the source model on the x-axis are used to select examples for the target model on the y-axis, aggregated across the three wrong-advice datasets. Diagonal entries therefore measure within-model attribution, while off-diagonal entries measure cross-model transfer. Cross-family attribution recovers a substantial fraction of the within-model filtering effect, and in some cases transfers as well as or better than attribution from another model in the same family.
blocks.zh: 图A15: 影响不同模范家庭的排名转移,但目标模型归属一般表现最好。 每个单元格测量x轴上来源模型的归属分数时获得的过滤缺口,用于选择y轴上的目标模型实例,在三个错误的advice数据集中汇总. 因此,对角条目测量模型内归属,而对角条目测量跨模型转移. 跨家庭归属可恢复相当一部分模式内过滤效应,在某些情况下,从同一家庭中的另一个模式转移或优于归属。

blocks.en: Figure A16: Influence transfer within the Qwen 2.5 family is asymmetric and does not depend monotonically on model size. Each heatmap shows the filtering gap when attribution scores computed using a Qwen 2.5 model of the source size on the x-axis are transferred to a target model of the size on the y-axis. The top-left panel aggregates all three datasets, with the remaining panels showing automotive, career, and educational advice separately. Attribution generally transfers between model sizes, but the strength of transfer varies substantially by direction and dataset; in particular, transferring from model A to model B need not work as well as transferring from B to A.
blocks.zh: 图A16: Quen 2.5家族内部的影响转移是不对称的,并不单靠模型大小. 每个热映射显示在使用x轴上源大小的Qwen 2.5模型计算归属分数时的过滤漏洞,被转移到y轴上大小的目标模型. 左上方的面板汇总了所有三个数据集,其余的面板分别显示汽车,职业,教育咨询. 分配一般在模型大小之间转移,但转移的强度因方向和数据集而有很大不同;特别是从模型A到模型B的转移不需要工作,也不需要从B到A的转移.

blocks.en: Figure A17: Influence transfer within the Qwen 3 family is asymmetric and varies by target size and dataset. Each heatmap reports the filtering gap obtained when attribution scores from a Qwen 3 source model of the size on the x-axis are used to select training examples for the target model on the y-axis. The aggregate result and the dataset-specific panels show that attribution transfers meaningfully across Qwen 3 model sizes, but the strength of transfer is not symmetric and there is no simple monotonic relationship between source-model size and transfer performance..
blocks.zh: 图A17: Quen 3家族内部的影响转移不对称,因目标大小和数据集而异. 每个热映射都报告从x轴大小的Quen 3源模型的归属得分时获得的过滤漏洞,用于选择y轴上的目标模型的训练实例. 汇总结果和数据集特定面板显示,归属在Quen 3模型大小之间有实际意义的转移,但转移的强度并不对称,源模型大小和转移性能之间没有简单的单调关系.
